facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, freely; no exchange restrictions, and the franc is pegged to the dollar.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Very likely, with no exchange controls; not confirmed.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways not confirmed yet; see the services listed above.
facts.L1_registration: Pay the yearly business licence fee (patente); registration steps not confirmed yet.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Business profits are taxed only on activity in Djibouti; personal rules unconfirmed.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 10% VAT for turnover above DJF 10–20m; exports are exempt.
facts.L5_data_protection: Digital Code 2025 covers personal data; its commission isn't set up yet.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: No online consumer protection law recorded in UNCTAD's tracker.
